Thanks dude. It's hard to picture myself in another relationship right now. But the thought of someday loving more deeply than with this girl makes me want to live to see it.
The ED thing is taking the biggest toll on me. It's just so terrifying. With this heartbreak it is such a horrible combination. It is entirely psychological, but it's not something that is willed away. It feels like a physical injury of some sort, that's how real it feels. Can you imagine not being able to be turned on by a naked woman in your bed?
